classes.name: index
classes.reason: _consume reads each index file once per unit and abandons the remaining reads ('return staged, True') as soon as 'probe.NS() - started > budget_ns', the budget being broadcast from the producer's write time, so each read must fit a time window; meanwhile the producers are held at the trailing barrier.wait() until the consumer finishes.

classes.name: statistics
classes.reason: _report loops 'for _pass in range(STATISTICS_READS)' re-reading each statistics file 8 times with no budget check, and all other ranks sit at the end-of-unit barrier.wait() while the consumer completes those blocking read_staged calls.
